in_arabic.name: داود
in_arabic.meaning: نبي الله داود عليه السلام، اسم علم مذكر
in_arabic.long_meaning: داود هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، وهو اسم نبي الله داود عليه السلام، ويعني الحبيب أو المحبوب، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، ويحمل دلالة عظيمة في التاريخ الإسلامي والتراث العربي

in_urdu.name: داؤد
in_urdu.meaning: پیغمبر اللہ داؤد علیہ السلام، مذکر اسم
in_urdu.long_meaning: داؤد ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے، اور یہ پیغمبر اللہ داؤد علیہ السلام کا نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محبوب یا پیارا، یہ نام قرآن کریم میں آیا ہے اور اسلامی تاریخ اور عربی ثقافت میں اس کی بڑی اہمیت ہے

in_hindi.name: दाऊद
in_hindi.meaning: परमेश्वर का पैगंबर दाऊद, पुल्लिंग नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: दाऊद एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है, और यह परमेश्वर के पैगंबर दाऊद का नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रिय या प्यारा, यह नाम कुरआन में आया है और इस्लामी इतिहास और अरबी संस्कृति में इसका बहुत महत्व है

in_pashto.name: داؤد
in_pashto.meaning: د سولې داعیم داؤد، مذکر نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: داؤد یو مذکر نوم دی چی عربي ريښی لری، او دا د سولې داعیم داؤد نوم دی، چی معنی یی د محبوب یا ګران دی، دا نوم په قرآن کریم کی راغلی دی او په اسلامي تاريخ او عربي کلتور کی یی لوی اهميت دی

in_english.name: Daood
in_english.meaning: Prophet of God, beloved, or loved one
in_english.long_meaning: Daood is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'beloved' or 'loved one'. It is the name of Prophet David in Islam, mentioned in the Quran. The name holds significant importance in Islamic tradition and history, symbolizing spiritual leadership and divine favor.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Daood" holds great cultural significance in Islamic tradition, as it belongs to one of the most revered prophets in Islam, Prophet Dawood (Solomon) peace be upon him. He is known for his wisdom, justice, and solid leadership. In various Muslim communities, especially those with strong cultural ties to the Middle East or North Africa, the name "Daood" is still common and cherished. It represents a connection to an esteemed figure in Islamic history and continues to remind us of the important role that righteous leaders can play in shaping communities and societies.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Daood" carries a profound spiritual significance as it derives from his role as an invitee and leader to Allah. Just like Prophet Dawood devoted his life to leading people towards Allah, this name serves as a reminder for its bearer to strive for inner and outer growth in knowledge, wisdom, discipline, and guidance. It encourages the individual to invite others to the path of righteousness and ultimately seek closer proximity to Allah. The name provides the bearer with a deep sense of purpose beyond the personal and invites them to become a beacon of light in the community, spreading knowledge, compassion, and wisdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gift" symbolizes The one who invites people to Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Daood serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gift.
